root_cause.text: The `cdc_ncm_rx_verify_ndp16()` function fails to include the `ndpoffset` when validating the size of the NDP16 header and its DPE array against the skb length, leading to out-of-bounds reads when the NDP is located near the end of the buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces the bounds check `if ((sizeof(struct usb_cdc_ncm_ndp16) + ret * (sizeof(struct usb_cdc_ncm_dpe16))) > skb_in->len)` with `if (ndpoffset + ndp_len > skb_in->len)`, where `ndp_len` is calculated using `struct_size_t(struct usb_cdc_ncm_ndp16, dpe16, ret)`.
